_comment: Hand-labelled ground-truth boxes for camera/zmilk/scanN.jpg, [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions of the 320x320 square. scan2/6/8 reuse the live finder's own box from that scan's trace - visually confirmed correct at the time (see CLAUDE.md, 4 Nov distance findings). scan1/3/4/5/7/9 are hand-measured by eye, since the finder's own box there is wrong (the whole point of this dataset) - rough but visually checked, not pixel-perfect.
